messages:
Maria Ops: heads up — vendor NexaSupply opened a partial RMA for our EU cluster. 2x A100 DOA, 1x A100 replacement delayed in transit. They want direction on consolidation vs separate returns.
Samir Infra: can you paste the AWBs? also which datacenter impacted?
Maria Ops: impacted: ams-1 (pod-gpu-12). AWBs:
```
Customer AWB: NL1234567890
Vendor outbound: NS9876543210
```
Lucy (NexaSupply): thanks — we received the photos and serials. We can either provision 2 replacements from our EU buffer and collect DOA units on one consolidated pickup, or schedule two separate pickups (carrier constraints). Consolidated pickup would need one AWB and we absorb the local pickup fee; splitting will add ~€120/leg.
Tom (RMA): note customs: if we consolidate into one international AWB returning to our UK repair depot, HS code 8471 might require additional paperwork. That can add 1-2 business days.
Maria Ops: preference is minimal downtime — can we expedite replacements from EU buffer? whats lead time if we do split?
Lucy (NexaSupply): expedite from EU buffer ok. Split shipments available tomorrow morning for collection, consolidated earliest pickup EOD tomorrow (needs a courier slot). If consolidated, vendor will cover pickup but NOT customs duties — those need cost center sign off.
Samir Infra: do we have spare racks to shift workloads? ams-1 can shed two jobs to ams-2, but network egress will add ~12ms and some queueing. Ops impact acceptable for 2–3 hours.
Maria Ops: agree — schedule consolidation to reduce handling if vendor covers pickup and insurance. Who signs for customs?
Tom (RMA): finance asked for cost-center and PO to accept duties. Please route to @finance with note. Suggested cost center: INFRA-REPLACEMENTS-2026.
supplybot: automated note — replacement SKUs reserved: RS-A100-48G x2 for customer RMA, hold until 2026-06-05.
Lucy (NexaSupply): re insurance — we can insure the consolidated return to vendor depot up to declared value if you provide serial list and commercial invoice. If you prefer vendor to issue return labels, we can generate DHL labels (DPU) and email to your facilities team.
Maria Ops: facilities: @facilities please confirm printing/attach labels at dock by 09:00 CET tomorrow. Also confirm who will sign AWB on pickup.
Samir Infra: for accounting — if vendor covers pickup cost but customs/duties land on us, estimate customs exposure ~€450-€850 depending on declared value. Lucy, can NexaSupply prepay duties on our behalf and invoice later?
Lucy (NexaSupply): we can prepay duties with vendor approval, then invoice Redwood. We need a billing contact and VAT details. Send to billing@nexasupply.example (we'll need Redwood VAT ref).
Tom (RMA): please ensure we log serials in the RMA tracker before handing to carrier. Use this snippet to export: `./rma export --cluster ams-1 --serials S/N1234,S/N1235,S/N1236 > rma_1718504321.csv`
Maria Ops: attaching serials here: S/N1234, S/N1235 = DOA, S/N1236 = delayed replacement in transit.
Samir Infra: got it. I'll start the workload migration at 07:30 CET so replacements can be swapped without job loss.
Lucy (NexaSupply): booking courier now. Consolidated AWB will be NLCONSOL-1718 (temp) — final AWB to follow. Expect pickup window 09:00-12:00 CET.
Maria Ops: great. Tom — once AWB arrives, please confirm customs docs and invoice routing so finance can pre-approve.
Tom (RMA): will do. Also flagging to eng-sre in case any latent hardware failures show up after swap.
Samir Infra: quick Q — if replacement arrives DOA again, what's the escalation? We should ask for immediate credit or same-day replacement.
Lucy (NexaSupply): escalation: if replacement is DOA on arrival, we will issue credit or expedite another replacement within 24 hours (subject to buffer stock). We'll add the clause in the RMA ticket.
Maria Ops: thanks all. next steps: 1) Lucy to send final AWB + labels, 2) Tom to confirm customs docs and cost center, 3) Samir to perform migration window, 4) Maria to coordinate facilities.
Maria Ops: :thumbsup:
Lucy (NexaSupply): AWB NLCONSOL-1718 final: NL000111222333. Labels emailed to facilities@redwood.example. Insurance declared value €38,500.
Tom (RMA): customs docs uploaded to rma drive: /rma/1718504321/docs. finance contact: erin.finance@redwood.example
Maria Ops: closing loop — pickup completed 2026-04-02 10:45 CET, carrier scan: DHL 10:45 CET pickup confirmed. Replacements installed, ams-1 back to normal. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
